title: Auto Job Applier user profile
description: One person's real data. Never share this file, commit it to a public repo, or reuse it for a different person. Copy profile.example.json to profile.json and fill in your own information.

name.description: Full name as it should appear on the CV.

work_authorization.description: e.g. 'UAE employment visa (transferable)', 'US citizen', 'Requires H-1B sponsorship'. Shown on the CV and used to answer visa screening questions truthfully - never invent this.

years_experience.description: Real, honest total professional experience in years. This is the single number used to filter which job listings to apply to - do not inflate it.

default_title.description: The headline/title used on the CV when no role-specific variant overrides it, e.g. 'Backend Engineer | Python, PostgreSQL, AWS'.

default_summary.description: 2-4 sentence professional summary in the person's own voice, truthful about scope and seniority. Role variants may override this; this is the fallback.

employment.description: Most recent first. Each entry's bullets are the raw pool a role variant can pick from.

id.description: Short key used by variants to select bullets from this role, e.g. 'current'.

text.description: A real, specific, defensible thing you did. No invented metrics.

skills.description: Grouped skills. Each group has an id so role variants can pick a subset to show.

additional.description: Free-text line for languages, certifications, travel/relocation notes, etc.

salary_policy.description: How to answer salary screening fields, if the person wants one used. Never invented if this is absent - see references/salary-and-screening-questions.md.

volunteer_in_outreach.description: Whether salary may be mentioned unprompted in emails/cover letters. Default false.

by_market.description: Map of a market label (e.g. 'remote_international', 'local_gcc') to the figure/string to use when a form requires one.
